meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why my son's mark was changed before anyone called me.
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, Hale? If I take that now, I'm agreeing Owen did something, and nobody has shown me a thing. What evidence do you have?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
"Generous." I'm not most parents, Hale, and I don't take offers from people who haven't shown me why. Is there a document, or isn't there?
Will you take it or not?
No. Withdraw the zero, apologise to Owen, and show me what you actually have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and the evidence you say you have, all in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position: nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see your evidence. That is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and it was not time that stopped you from reaching it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put anything in front of her that she could check.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence, then called it generous and said most parents would take it, which made her hear an admission being bought rather than a case being made.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. You never raised a time or a date, so your evidence did not come near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after her opening complaint about the mark changing before anyone called, own that in one sentence, then put one dated document in front of her before you mention any rewrite.
